title: hutchinsia rotundifolia subsp. cenisia
intro: Hutchinsia rotundifolia subsp. cenisia, commonly known as Alpine Hutchinsia, is a plant species within the Saxifragaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including the treatment of coughs, colds, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Hutchinsia rotundifolia subsp. cenisia include its ability to relieve congestion, reduce fever, and soothe sore throats. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
